args.text:
Batch: 15 runs, 15 accepted, 15 flagged, 0 cleared. All flags are check_failed_but_accepted.
- r02, r06, r10, r12, r13, r15 failed all three checks: rigid invariance, closure and plane sections. r12's profile is also unlike the batch (peak at 53 µm, growth zone 105 µm). r06, r13 and r15 have very large flank differences (-83 to -173 %/h).
- r01, r05, r11 failed rigid invariance and plane sections. Their REGR peaks (74–122 %/h) and growth zones (263–410 µm) are also far from the batch.
- r03, r04, r14 failed plane sections (9.0–11.3 against 3.25). Their other checks pass and their summaries look like the batch.
- r07, r08, r09 failed closure (about 2.9 against 1.0). Their other checks pass and their summaries look like the batch.
What the flagged runs share: every run failed at least one final check and was still accepted. Every run was a single step with no remedies kept and no roll backs, and none used the width-free ratio, so the plane-sections failures count. Because every accepted run failed, the acceptance step itself looks faulty for this batch. Whatever accepted these runs should be checked before any strain-rate, velocity or curvature profile from the batch is reported.
